business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Student Placement and Golden Visa Residence Advisory

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (based on Colombian Civil Code; influenced by Code of Commerce and Administrative Code, with limited common law influences in regulatory practice)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (creation of UIAF); Law 1121 of 2007 (AML/CFT framework); Law 2010 of 2019 (final beneficiary disclosure); Decree 830 of 2021 and DIAN Resolution 164 of 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB); Circular 8 of 2024 of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (SARLAFT/AML obligations for companies); FATF Recommendations as incorporated in Colombia's domestic regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign Certificate of Incorporation / Equivalent Existence Document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly recognized corporate registry / competent notary in the natural person's or corporate shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention (Colombia, effective 2013) or Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Passport or National Identity Document for Each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry / passport authority of country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified Spanish translation by an official translator in Colombia

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Proof of Source of Funds / Source of Wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank under bribery and AML compliance standards
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified Spanish translation; must be current at filing date

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Criminal Record Certificate from Country of Domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national police or judicial authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified Spanish translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and UBOs against the Colombian UIAF National PEP List, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and the Colombian Attorney General's criminal records. Screening must be performed at incorporation and continuously under a risk-based SARLAFT system.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE) – www.vue.gov.co, coordinated with the Dual Registry of the Camara de Comercio via the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES – www.rues.org.co); name search available at sociedades.registro.gov.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be rendered in the Spanish alphabet; foreign words are permitted only if transliterated to Latin characters and must be phonetically coherent in Spanish. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names and may include 'S.A.S.' or 'SAS' as the mandatory abbreviated suffix for Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Colombia (unless specifically authorized by the Ministry of Interior and the relevant sectoral ministry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the legal representative may file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the competent Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days under Ley 1437 of 2011 (Código de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo). The appeal must set forth the distinctive features of the proposed name and any markings that sufficiently differentiate it from prior registrations. If the Chamber maintains rejection, the applicant may pursue a second administrative action (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within the same statutory framework.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for registry and basic postal purposes, but conditioned on the SAS maintaining a 'domicilio social' in Colombia and, due to the immigration-consulting nature, the competent authority (Ministry of Justice / DIAN) may require a physical office for client interviews and documentary custody. Virtual-office arrangements will be accepted only with a registered agent and an explicit address in Bogotá D.C.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — approximate 45% annualized probability of unannounced on-site inspection by DIAN or the Superintendencia de Sociedades during the first three years of operation, given the enhanced AML risk tier for immigration and visa consulting services.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee (per name, Camara de Comercio de Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Superintendencia de Sociedades Resolución; flat rate per query

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation deed notary public fees (SAS public instrument)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Tariff set by Decreto 1274 of 2002 and local notarial regulations; scaled by capital amount, approximated at baseline

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce registration fee (matrícula mercantil inicial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory base tariff plus proportional fee based on nominal capital (approx. 0.4% of capital up to a cap)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legalization of books (libro de actas, libro de registro de socios)
Apostille, notarization, and sworn translation of foreign UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign competent authorities plus an official translator in Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark — apostille fees vary by country; sworn translation fees fixed by Colombian translators' tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO Registration (RUB) initial filing before DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory filing fee for UBO registration; compliance cost reflects professional preparation time, shown separately under professional advisory

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional pre-incorporation due-diligence advisory and AML/CFT file preparation (law firm fees)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External legal counsel / licensed attorney in Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market standard hourly/fixed-rate advisory benchmark for medium risk SAS incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Miscellaneous administrative fees (certificates, RUES forms, police information certificates)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Camara de Comercio and local police / Migration Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory base tariffs and registry certificate issuance fees

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), articles 1-12 and 22-31; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), articles 110, 119 and 158; Decreto 1074 de 2015, articles 6.3.1.1 et seq. (electronic commercial registry).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social, integrated nationally through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) and the Cámara de Comercio online filing portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Instrument) filed with the Commercial Registry; notarized Escritura Pública is required only if real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No mandatory minimum paid-up capital for an S.A.S. under Colombian law. The authorized, subscribed and paid capital is set freely in the bylaws. At least one share must be subscribed before registration; payment of the subscribed but unpaid balance may be deferred according to the shareholders' payment schedule. An escrow account is not statutorily required but is strongly recommended for holding client funds under the target payment rails.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The founding shareholders of Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada hereby adopt the following resolutions. First: The authorized, subscribed and paid share capital set forth in the corporate bylaws is ratified, and each subscriber irrevocably accepts its shares. Second: The statutory registered office is established at Calle [address], Bogotá, Jurisdiction of Colombia, and branch offices may be opened upon board approval. Third: [Full Name] is appointed Legal Representative and General Manager, and [Full Name] is appointed Compliance Officer, each with broad corporate powers. Fourth: The Legal Representative is authorized to complete all registrations, open bank and escrow accounts, and apply for statutory operating licenses. Fifth: These resolutions are effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá via RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search up to three proposed corporate names in the RUES homonym consultation module. Select an available name, submit the formal reservation request through the Chamber's electronic system, pay the reservation fee, and obtain a name reservation certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID of each incorporator
Power of attorney if using a representative
Certificate of no conflicting registered trademark (optional but recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity, file a reconsideration petition with the Chamber, present a distinct trademark/name conflict report, or reserve an alternative name. A new reservation can be submitted immediately without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate counsel, founding shareholders, and, if real property is contributed, a Public Notary in the jurisdiction of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the corporate name, domicile, duration, share classes, voting rules, capital payment terms, board structure and initial officers. Execute the document with all shareholders personally or electronically. If the contribution includes real property, formalize before a notary public and record the deed.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each founding shareholder
Proof of capital subscription or payment plan
Shareholders' register with voting and economic rights
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the document is defective, the shareholders may execute an addendum or corrective amendment and re-file the instrument. A notarial refusal is cured by scheduling a new notarial hearing or by removing real-property contributions and filing as a private document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Registration of Draft RUT and Provisional NIT with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) virtual office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access DIAN's Registro Único Tributario module, create the pre-inscription as 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada', upload the draft private incorporation instrument, and enter the legal representative's data. Obtain the provisional NIT and the draft RUT to be used in the commercial registry filing.
required_dossiers: Legal representative's national ID or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the pre-registration for data mismatch, correct the identified inconsistencies and resubmit in the virtual office. If the provisional NIT is blocked, contact DIAN assistance and furnish a corrected constituent document within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing and Certificate of Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed private incorporation instrument and provisional RUT/NIT to the Chamber's electronic incorporation module. Pay the registration tax and administrative fees, then submit the filing. Upon successful review, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an 'requerimiento de subsanación', cure the formal defect within the stated term, pay any corrected registration tax, and resubmit. Administrative appeals (recurso de reposición and apelación) are available against a final rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Finalization of RUT, Corporate Bank and Escrow Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN and a supervised financial entity in Colombia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation, finalize the RUT with DIAN to obtain the definitive NIT and electronic billing authorization. Open the corporate checking account and the segregated escrow account for client deposits. Complete the bank's AML/KYC onboarding, submit the beneficial ownership declaration, and activate online banking.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the file for AML/KYC reasons, provide an enhanced organizational chart, source-of-funds evidence, and a good-standing certificate from the Chamber. Re-file with the bank's compliance committee or choose a secondary regulated institution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for consumer contracting, Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores for immigration-related liaison, and Unidad Administrativa Especial del Servicio Público de Empleo under the Ministerio del Trabajo if placement services are also provided.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Study-Abroad and Visa Consulting Operating License under the Servicio Público de Empleo and Registro Nacional de Turismo (if international travel packages are included), together with the Chamber of Commerce Matrícula Mercantil.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and municipal environmental authority under Law 99 of 1993 and Decreto 1076 de 2015
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category not requiring an EIA or environmental registration because the business is an office-based consulting service; a change to physical venue or regulated accommodation would trigger a reassessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater, VOC emissions, or industrial discharges. Office waste handling must comply with Resolución 2184 de 2019 (color-coded recycling) and municipal solid waste rules; electronic and battery waste must be delivered to licensed recyclers. Indoor occupancy must meet national building ventilation and occupational health guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the local Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos, structural load and safe-occupancy certificate from the local Curaduría Urbana or municipality, and workplace health and safety assessment under Resolución 0312 de 2019, including fire extinguishers, evacuation routes and first-aid equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; all electronic registration, filing, and invoice clearance operate through MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado); municipal ICA tax is administered separately by the local municipality (e.g., Bogotá Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Colombian S.A.S. obtains its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) automatically at incorporation through the Cámara de Comercio platform, with simultaneous RUT (Registro Único Tributario) inscription. A foreign entity without local incorporation must appoint a Colombian-domiciled legal representative with power of attorney and file Form 002 (RUT update) via MUISCA, receiving a provisional NIT before definitive registration. Obtaining a DIAN-issued digital certificate (firma electrónica) from DIAN or an authorized certifier (e.g., GSE, Certicámara) is mandatory for all electronic filings, invoice authorization, and export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Colombian-resident S.A.S. is a per-se taxable company subject to worldwide income taxation at the 35% corporate income tax rate (FY2024); branches or permanent establishments of foreign enterprises are taxed only on Colombian-source income. The S.A.S. is not eligible for pass-through treatment or tax-exempt zone classification. Territorial VAT jurisdiction applies to services consumed domestically; qualifying service exports are zero-rated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no U.S.-style check-the-box regime. Available statutory elections include: (i) legal stability agreement (convenio de estabilidad jurídica) freezing tax rules for up to 20 years; (ii) prior-approved DIAN petition to elect Colombian Holding Company (CHC) treatment under Articles 894-906 ET; (iii) depreciation method election under Article 134 ET; (iv) exporters' election to request periodic VAT refunds on a monthly or bimonthly basis under Article 855 ET; (v) dividend distribution election from already-taxed reserves to obtain the reduced 10% remittance tax instead of the residual 33% rate; hybrid mismatch rules follow OECD BEPS Action 2 with no elective treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax — IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas), governed by Title V of the Estatuto Tributario; supplementary levies include the National Consumption Tax (INC) and municipal ICA, neither of which applies to professional study-abroad and immigration visa advisory services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for legal entities: every S.A.S., regardless of income, must register as a responsible del IVA in the common regime. Natural persons and artisans may remain in the simplified regime only if prior-year gross income does not exceed 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 164,727,500 for 2024; UVT = COP 47,065) and they meet the statutory asset and location tests; this simplification is unavailable to corporations or to service providers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance: each sale requires issuance of an electronic invoice (factura electrónica) transmitted in XML to DIAN, which returns a digital stamp — CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) — before the invoice is legally enforceable. Under Resolution 000165/2023, the new FEV (Factura Electrónica de Venta) regime imposes 'validación previa' (pre-clearance through API/web-service integration) on taxpayers issuing more than 1,000 annual e-invoices, with a two-day post-validation window for smaller issuers. Export invoices must also be cleared in MUISCA and goods movements must transmit dispatch and receipt events to DIAN.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Services qualify for the 0% VAT export rate only if: (i) the purchaser is a non-resident person or entity without a Colombian permanent establishment; (ii) the service is utilized exclusively abroad; and (iii) the service falls within Decree 2201/2016 categories (including consulting, management assistance, and education-related advisory services) or its economic benefit is realized entirely outside Colombia. Study-abroad placement and golden visa advisory rendered to foreign clients — foreign students or investors with all value generated and consumed abroad — is zero-rated, with the right to claim refund of input VAT. Services provided to Colombian residents for their own emigration, student visa, or relocation process are domestic VATable services at 19%, even if the destination country is abroad. Substantiation requires a signed contract, export invoice, the foreign client's tax residence certificate, and the annual Export of Services Report under Decree 2247/2014.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Service Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación de Servicios) filed electronically in MUISCA
Commercial invoice and service contract reflecting the 0% VAT rate and export-specific clauses
Foreign client's certificate of tax residence and written confirmation of no permanent establishment in Colombia
Certificate of foreign exchange negotiation and settlement (Certificado de Negociación y Liquidación de Divisas) issued by a Colombian authorized intermediary bank
SWIFT MT103 or wire transfer proof evidencing actual receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN electronically cross-matches export declarations, VAT returns, e-invoice data, and foreign-exchange settlement reports; any inconsistency triggers fiscal verification. An improperly obtained VAT refund is clawed back with moratory interest (1.5x the ordinary lending rate) and a penalty of 100% of the refunded amount under Articles 648 and 670 ET; inaccurate-return penalties reach 100% of omitted tax, plus administrative fines up to 5,000 UVT imposed on the legal representative, who is jointly and severally liable. Fraudulent zero-rating or forged export documentation constitutes criminal tax fraud under Law 1762/2015, punishable by 4 to 9 years' imprisonment; for goods customs exports, false declarations additionally attract customs penalties of up to 300% of FOB value.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the central bank) and the Comisión de Cambios (foreign exchange commission comprising the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Trade/Industry/Tourism, and the Central Bank Manager) constitute the joint monetary and exchange authority. The governing instruments are Law 9 of 1991, Ley 31 of 1992, and Circular Reglamentaria D.C.I.N. 83 of the Banco de la República. All cross-border settlements of this SAS must flow through the authorized foreign exchange market (mercado cambiario) and be physically processed by commercial banks acting as intermediaries; the DIAN supervises the tax-related documentation supporting each flow.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible for current-account transactions: collections from study-abroad consulting and placement services may be converted without prior central bank authorization, but every incoming or outgoing wire requires a signed Declaración de Cambio (Form 4 for services exports, Form 3 for services imports). Capital-account transactions are open but highly formal: an inbound equity investment must be registered as inversión internacional with Banco de la República within 12 months of entry, and the registration is a legal precondition for future dividend remittances and capital repatriation. In practice, banks enforce strict purpose-of-payment references, require a tax clearance statement (paz y salvo) for large profit remittances, and the absence of deep COP correspondent networks in non-LatAm corridors forces a USD or EUR settlement leg for most cross-border operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Services-export proceeds (including visa advisory fees, consultancy retainers, and placement commissions) are subject to the canalización obligation: 100% of each service export must be channeled into the Colombian exchange market within six months following the date of service provision under D.C.I.N. 83. The exporter must either (i) sell the foreign currency to a local authorized intermediary and receive COP, or (ii) maintain the funds in a registered cuenta de compensación abroad or in a local foreign-currency account, with any unutilized balance channeled into COP within the same legal term. Each transaction is declared through Form 4 submitted by the settling bank. Delayed or omitted channeling triggers fines under the Colombian exchange-control disciplinary regime and materially weakens the company's standing for future FX hedging authorizations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - Cuenta Corriente COP with dedicated FX conversion desk
Capital Escrow Account - Patrimonio Autónomo / Cuenta de Garantía for client tuition funds
Operational Account - Cuenta Corriente COP with USD sub-account for foreign-currency receipts
Capital Escrow Account - Fideicomiso de Garantía for segregated student funds
Operational Account and Escrow via FiduDavivienda S.A.
Operational Account - Cuenta Corriente with cross-border payments platform
Operational Account with international trade and treasury desk
Operational Account - Cuenta Corriente COP with FX derivatives desk
Operational Account - Cuenta de Ahorros COP, limited suitability for cross-border flows
Operational Account (state-owned; not specialized in commercial cross-border services)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary collection, Low for treasury-grade escrow and clearing. Colombia does not recognize the EU-style EMI license; digital deposit institutions (SEDPEs such as Nequi, Movii, Dale) hold funds through regulated banks and cannot offer multi-currency corporate accounts, SWIFT-connected settlement, or escrow structures. Offshore EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, dLocal) may collect advisory fees in USD/EUR from foreign student-clients, but the proceeds must be settled into a local Colombian bank account in the name of the SAS to satisfy the exchange-market channeling rule. Offshore EMIs are legally barred from holding client escrow positions in COP and cannot replace the Tier-1 bank clearing rail; they complement the structure only for merchant-style collection in corridors where SWIFT costs are prohibitive.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a non-resident-owned SAS, banking KYC requires the legal representative or a formally appointed attorney-in-fact to undergo an identity interview; in practice, Tier-1 banks require at least one physical appearance of the registered legal representative (or of the controlling shareholder if acting as account signatory) at a branch in Bogotá, Medellín, Barranquilla, or Cali. Remote onboarding is technically permitted under the digital onboarding rules where the signatory holds a valid Colombian cédula or residence permit, but the bank's SAGRILAFT internal policy will normally compel a video interview with the compliance officer and presentation of apostilled corporate documents. The pragmatic roadmap: appoint a resident legal representative in Colombia, register the appointment in the Cámara de Comercio, execute an apostilled power of attorney for bank-signing authority, and complete a single in-person or high-assurance virtual identity verification session before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner resident in a FATF-watchlisted or Colombian high-risk jurisdiction, or categorized as a politically exposed person (PEP), triggering automatic bank adverse media screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled passport copy; notarized Beneficiario Final declaration; police/background certificates from the residence jurisdiction; sworn source-of-funds letter describing the equity injection; prior bank reference letters; commercial references; and a legal opinion confirming the immigration/study-abroad activity is lawful under Decreto 1067 of 2015.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The study-abroad and visa-consulting classification triggers UIAF anti-money-laundering typologies: acting as an informal remitter of student tuition, cash concentration from multiple payers, or fee mismatches between consulting invoices and subsequent outbound transfers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Model professional services contract; itemized invoices tied to the ISIC 7810 scope; executed student enrollment agreements and visa-application receipts from migration authorities; documentation of zero-rated VAT treatment on exported services; a written policy prohibiting cash collections above COP 10 million per transaction; UIAF-compliant transaction monitoring and Suspicious Transaction Report procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound wires from family members or foreign universities where the remitter and the beneficial student differ, producing payer/beneficiary mismatches and potential structuring flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed client instruction authorizing the third-party payment; source-of-funds declaration from the remitter; student passport copy and visa application reference; the contractual right of the SAS to route escrowed funds directly to the university; and an internal policy allowing disbursement only to the original beneficiary or tuition creditor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Absence of a formal AML/SAGRILAFT program for a consultancy that the bank perceives as a non-financial obliged entity, causing the compliance committee to reject the account application.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed SAGRILAFT manual; designation of an oficial de cumplimiento; staff AML training records; a documented client risk-matrix (4-step segmentation); prohibition of any dealings with shell companies; and a register evidencing enhanced due diligence for clients or remitters in high-risk jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders wire equity via SWIFT MT103 to the SAS operational account using the reference 'INVESTMENT IN CAPITAL' and the exact registered corporate name as beneficiary; the receiving bank converts USD/EUR into COP at the Tasa Representativa del Mercado and files the Declaración de Cambio Form No. 6; the SAS completes the Banco de la República Registro Internacional de Inversiones within 12 months, attaching the bylaws, RUT, Cámara de Comercio certificate, and the notarized capital-increase minutes. The routing discipline is one wire per capital call, no mixing with operating revenues, and a complete prohibition on third-party payers contacting the capital account. Client escrow funds must be segregated in a separate trust/escrow account and must never enter the operational COP account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For settlement of foreign university tuition, exam fees, and immigration application fees on behalf of student-clients, the SAS executes SWIFT MT103 transfers from its COP or USD facility in favor of the foreign institution; the bank files the Declaración de Cambio Form No. 3 (Importación de Servicios) attaching the tuition invoice, the student instruction, and the enrollment confirmation as underlying documentation. Where client funds have been escrowed, disbursement is made from the fiduciary trust account only against a university invoice and a written student instruction verified by the compliance officer. Commercial letters of credit (MT700) are restricted to physical goods (textbooks, equipment) and are not appropriate for recurring service flows. For high-volume tuition seasons, the SAS should agree a monthly batch-disbursement schedule with the bank, subject to per-wire enhanced due-diligence triggers at USD 50,000 and to a strict reconciliation report by student name.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable COP/USD forward contracts (forwards de cumplimiento financiero) executed through the local bank treasury desk against documented underlying commercial exposure (export receivables for consulting fees or committed tuition liabilities).
Non-deliverable COP/USD forwards (NDFs) used for offshore counterparties or where physical COP delivery is impractical; must be designated and documented under IFRS 9 hedge accounting.
COP/USD cross-currency swaps (swaps de moneda) aligned to the tuition collection and disbursement calendar to smooth seasonal liquidity mismatches.

Plain-vanilla COP/USD and COP/EUR currency options (call/put spreads) to cap depreciation-driven cost increases on future tuition payments; banks will verify that the notional amount is proportional to confirmed exposure.
COP/CAD and COP/GBP forward contracts for education corridors in Canada and the United Kingdom where tuition is levied in local currency and the Colombian consulting fee is invoiced in COP.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge on the renewal tariff, fixed penalties per DIAN, and risk of administrative strike-off from the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Filing (Estados Financieros del ejercicio anterior)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 following the fiscal year-end (after approval by the sole shareholder or shareholders' meeting held by March 31)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 10,000 UVT (approximately USD 12,000) and evidentiary loss of the company's good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between approximately August 8 and September 28, based on the last two digits of the company's NIT, as published in the DIAN calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax assessed per month or fraction thereof, plus interest; possible NIT suspension and administrative penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation (Actualización Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of the initial RUB registration, and also within 30 calendar days after any shareholding transfer or material change in beneficiary ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 1,500 UVT (approximately USD 1,900) for non-compliance or late update, per DIAN enforcement rules.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (Revisor Fiscal) applies to a S.A.S. if total gross assets exceed 5,000 current monthly legal minimum wages (approx. COP 5,600 million for 2025) or annual gross income exceeds 3,000 monthly legal minimum wages (approx. COP 3,360 million), or if the company elects such appointment in its bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (Full NIIF for large entities; NIIF para PYME for small and medium entities, including most S.A.S.)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The legal representative must file an annual confirmation/update of the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) with DIAN within 30 calendar days of each anniversary of the initial filing, and additionally must update the RUB within 30 calendar days after any transfer of shares, change in ownership percentage, or change in ultimate beneficial owner.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Actas de la Asamblea
Libro de Acta de Junta Directiva

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Registered agent and registered office fees typically range from USD 300 to USD 800 per year.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Certified audit and financial statement preparation fees for a S.A.S. typically range from USD 2,000 to USD 6,000 per year, depending on transaction volume.

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None in the form of tax holidays for S.A.S.; targeted incentives: 25% additional deduction for R&D capex (Art. 158-1 E.T.); unconditional deduction for employment of young workers (Art. 108-1? actually 'nómina electrónica'?), 25% deduction for donations to art/culture (Art. 125-4); VAT exclusion for education services (Art. 476 E.T.); income tax 'priming'? etc.
